title: Are All Plant Proteins Incomplete?

scenes.text: Many think all plant proteins lack essential amino acids.
scenes.label: MYTH: All plant proteins are incomplete.
scenes.hook_top: MANY THINK ALL PLANT PROTEINS LACK

scenes.text: Some plant proteins, like quinoa and soy, are complete sources of protein with all essential amino acids.
scenes.label: TRUTH: Some are complete proteins.

scenes.text: Balance your protein sources to meet all amino acid needs.
scenes.label: TAKEAWAY: Mix your proteins!

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: Are all plant proteins flawed? Uncover the truth about their amino acid profiles and learn how to balance your protein intake. Follow for more!
